title: Calendar PATCH on attendees resets everyone's RSVP to needsAction
symptoms: Attendees who had accepted show as awaiting response after the update
responseStatus is needsAction for every attendee
cause: A PATCH that includes attendees replaces the whole array. Any attendee sent without responseStatus gets the default.
fix: Read the event first and send every existing attendee back with its responseStatus, plus the new one.
